author: Kushal
problem: heat_a and heat_b are the results of two swimming heats, each a list of (name, seconds) sorted from fastest to slowest. Return the combined results from fastest to slowest, where a heat A swimmer goes ahead of a heat B swimmer with the same time and each heat keeps its own order.
bug_description: Takes from heat A only when its time is < heat B's instead of <=, so on equal times the heat B swimmer is placed first.

comments.accurate: Merges both heats into one ranking from fastest to slowest
comments.wrong_behavior: Merges both heats fastest first; on equal times the heat B swimmer is listed first
comments.wrong_location: Time comparison checked; leftover swimmers may be appended in the wrong order
